contentBlocks.description: Verified regional contact details published by SASSA. This page does not confirm a separate Cape Town local office branch at the previously listed address.

contentBlocks.text: The address and phone number previously shown on this page for the Cape Town local office could not be verified against the current SASSA contact directory. To avoid sending beneficiaries to an incorrect location, those local-branch claims have been removed. SASSA's published Western Cape regional office contact is listed below.

contentBlocks.address: Golden Acre, Adderley Street, Cape Town, 8000
contentBlocks.operatingHours: The regional contact directory does not confirm local branch operating hours. Call before visiting.
contentBlocks.accessibilityNotes: Accessibility details for this regional office are not specified in the contact directory.
contentBlocks.nearbyLandmarks: This is the provincial regional office contact, not confirmation of a separate local branch in the city named in this page's URL.

contentBlocks.title: Before travelling
contentBlocks.text: For the nearest local office, confirm the address, service availability and opening hours with SASSA on 0800 60 10 11. Do not rely on the previously published local branch address or phone number.
Source checked 13 November 2026: SASSA official Contact Us directory — https://services.sassa.gov.za/portal/r/sassa/sassa/contact-us-pu. Regional email: GrantsEnquiriesWC@sassa.gov.za.
